const p = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboWits limited-mode episode controller and action record."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs/align_blocks")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def connect() -> Robot:
+    return Robot()
+
+
+def save_observation(obs, label: str = "obs") -> None:
+    from PIL import Image
+
+    target = RUNS / label
+    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(target / f"{camera}.jpg", quality=95)
+    if obs.last_depth:
+        for camera, depth in obs.last_depth.items():
+            np.save(target / f"{camera}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (target / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+def joint_state(obs) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)[:16]
+
+
+def move_joints(robot: Robot, obs, target, seconds: float = 1.0, *, video="mp4"):
+    """Smooth joint-position move from the most recent proprio state."""
+    start = joint_state(obs)
+    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float64)
+    steps = max(1, int(np.ceil(seconds / 0.1)))
+    actions = np.linspace(start, target, steps + 1, dtype=np.float32)[1:]
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=seconds / steps, video=video)
+
+
+def move_ee(robot: Robot, right, left, *, rows: int = 1, video="mp4"):
+    """Submit paired gripper-tip targets; each pose is xyz + quaternion wxyz + opening."""
+    row = np.r_[np.asarray(right, dtype=np.float64), np.asarray(left, dtype=np.float64)]
+    return robot.submit("ee_pose", np.repeat(row[None, :], rows, axis=0), video=video)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    robot = connect()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    print("connected", spec.get("protocol"), flush=True)
+    print(json.dumps({k: spec.get(k) for k in ("actions", "default_cameras", "proprio_groups", "budget", "world")}, indent=2), flush=True)
+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+    save_observation(obs, "initial")
+    print("initial observation saved", flush=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(p));

+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+# Gripper tip +z points downward; local +x closes along world +y.
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 2**-0.5, 2**-0.5, 0.0])
+Q_HOME_LEFT = np.array([0.37815, 0.59789, 0.59731, 0.37815])
+TABLE_Z = 0.756
+PICK_TCP_Z = 0.766
+SAFE_TCP_Z = 0.91
+LINE_X = 0.52
+LINE_Y = (-0.14, 0.0, 0.14)
+
+# Centers estimated from the initial RGB-D frame, followed by centers
+# re-estimated from the camera after the first placement.
+INITIAL_CUBE_C = (0.4653, 0.2086)
+OBSERVED_CUBE_A_AFTER_C = (0.5624, 0.1774)
+OBSERVED_CUBE_B_BEFORE_MOVE = (0.4941, -0.0857)
+
+ACTION_LOG: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+
+def save_observation(obs, label: str) -> None:
+    from PIL import Image
+
+    target = RUNS / label
+    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(target / f"{camera}.jpg", quality=95)
+    for camera, depth in obs.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(target / f"{camera}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (target / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+def observe(robot: Robot, label: str, seconds: float = 0.0):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(seconds=seconds, depth=True, video="none")
+    save_observation(obs, label)
+    return obs
+
+
+def _state(obs) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)
+
+
+def _pose_pair(obs, arm: str, target: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    now = _state(obs)
+    right = np.r_[now[16:23], now[7]]
+    left = np.r_[now[23:30], now[15]]
+    if arm == "right":
+        right = np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float64)
+    elif arm == "left":
+        left = np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float64)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("arm must be 'right' or 'left'")
+    return np.r_[right, left]
+
+
+def _record(label: str, result, action: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    ACTION_LOG.append({
+        "label": label,
+        "action": action,
+        "step": result.meta.get("step"),
+        "time_left_s": result.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        "control_steps_chunk": result.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+        "plan": result.meta.get("plan"),
+        "clipped": result.meta.get("clipped"),
+        "done": result.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": result.meta.get("reason"),
+    })
+
+
+def ee_target(robot: Robot, obs, arm: str, xyz_q_opening, label: str):
+    target = np.asarray(xyz_q_opening, dtype=np.float64)
+    result = robot.submit(
+        "ee_pose", _pose_pair(obs, arm, target)[None, :], video="none", note=label
+    )
+    _record(label, result, {"type": "ee_pose", "arm": arm, "target": target.tolist()})
+    return result
+
+
+def gripper(robot: Robot, obs, arm: str, opening: float, label: str, seconds: float = 0.5):
+    start = _state(obs)[:16]
+    target = start.copy()
+    index = 7 if arm == "right" else 15
+    target[index] = float(opening)
+    steps = max(1, int(np.ceil(seconds / 0.1)))
+    actions = np.linspace(start, target, steps + 1, dtype=np.float32)[1:]
+    result = robot.submit(
+        "joint_position", actions, dt=seconds / steps, video="none", note=label
+    )
+    _record(label, result, {
+        "type": "joint_position",
+        "arm": arm,
+        "opening": float(opening),
+        "seconds": float(seconds),
+    })
+    return result
+
+
+def _pose(xy, z: float, opening: float, quaternion=Q_DOWN) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.r_[np.asarray(xy, dtype=np.float64), z, quaternion, opening]
+
+
+def move_cube(robot: Robot, obs, *, arm: str, source_xy, target_xy, name: str):
+    """Pick at source and set down at target using a high waypoint."""
+    source_xy = np.asarray(source_xy, dtype=np.float64)
+    target_xy = np.asarray(target_xy, dtype=np.float64)
+
+    ee_target(robot, obs, arm, _pose(source_xy, SAFE_TCP_Z, 0.09), f"{name}: approach")
+    obs = observe(robot, f"{name}_approach", 0.4)
+    ee_target(robot, obs, arm, _pose(source_xy, PICK_TCP_Z, 0.09), f"{name}: descend")
+    obs = observe(robot, f"{name}_grasp_height", 0.8)
+    gripper(robot, obs, arm, 0.0, f"{name}: close")
+    obs = observe(robot, f"{name}_closed")
+
+    ee_target(robot, obs, arm, _pose(source_xy, SAFE_TCP_Z, 0.0), f"{name}: lift")
+    obs = observe(robot, f"{name}_lifted", 0.7)
+    ee_target(robot, obs, arm, _pose(target_xy, SAFE_TCP_Z, 0.0), f"{name}: carry")
+    obs = observe(robot, f"{name}_carried", 0.4)
+    ee_target(robot, obs, arm, _pose(target_xy, PICK_TCP_Z, 0.0), f"{name}: lower")
+    obs = observe(robot, f"{name}_lowered", 0.8)
+    gripper(robot, obs, arm, 0.09, f"{name}: release", seconds=0.4)
+    obs = observe(robot, f"{name}_released", 0.35)
+    ee_target(robot, obs, arm, _pose(target_xy, SAFE_TCP_Z, 0.09), f"{name}: retreat")
+    return observe(robot, f"{name}_placed", 0.5)
+
+
+def _save_record(status: dict[str, Any] | None) -> None:
+    (RUNS / "action_record.json").write_text(json.dumps(ACTION_LOG, indent=2))
+    if status is not None:
+        (RUNS / "final_status.json").write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
+
+
+def run_episode() -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    """Run the recorded, single-episode manipulation sequence."""
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    (RUNS / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+    obs = observe(robot, "initial")
+    status = None
+    try:
+        # First cube moved to the positive-y endpoint. The initial placement
+        # nudged the neighboring cube; its post-placement camera center is used
+        # below, matching the observations from this successful episode.
+        obs = move_cube(
+            robot, obs, arm="left", source_xy=INITIAL_CUBE_C,
+            target_xy=(LINE_X, LINE_Y[2]), name="cube_C_positive_end",
+        )
+        obs = move_cube(
+            robot, obs, arm="left", source_xy=OBSERVED_CUBE_A_AFTER_C,
+            target_xy=(LINE_X, LINE_Y[1]), name="cube_A_middle",
+        )
+
+        ee_target(
+            robot, obs, "left",
+            np.r_[0.70, 0.35, 0.95, Q_HOME_LEFT, 0.09],
+            "park left arm high",
+        )
+        obs = observe(robot, "clear_view", 0.5)
+
+        # The service detected success as this final placement was released.
+        obs = move_cube(
+            robot, obs, arm="right", source_xy=OBSERVED_CUBE_B_BEFORE_MOVE,
+            target_xy=(LINE_X, LINE_Y[0]), name="cube_B_negative_end",
+        )
+    except EpisodeOver as exc:
+        ACTION_LOG.append({"label": "episode_over", "reason": str(exc)})
+    finally:
+        try:
+            status = robot.status()
+        except Exception as exc:  # retain the action record if status is unavailable
+            ACTION_LOG.append({"label": "status_error", "error": str(exc)})
+        _save_record(status)
+    print(json.dumps(status, indent=2), flush=True)
+    return status
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run_episode()
*** End Patch";
